business_problem: AdventHealth wanted to improve early detection of precancerous polyps and colon cancer during routine colonoscopies by reducing missed lesions and increasing adenoma detection rates.
solution_summary: AdventHealth West Florida rolled out Medtronic’s GI Genius™ intelligent endoscopy module across its hospitals to add AI-assisted detection to routine colonoscopy workflows. In this deployment, the input is the live visual stream generated during the colonoscopy. GI Genius processes that stream in real time and acts as a “second set of eyes,” highlighting suspected precancerous polyps and adenomas so the endoscopist can inspect them immediately during the same procedure. The article ties the module directly to higher adenoma detection rates and fewer missed lesions, while noting no added procedural time or extra patient cost. No separate storage tier, model-training environment, or downstream analytics stack is described; the implementation presented is a point-of-care clinical decision support layer embedded in existing endoscopy practice across AdventHealth’s West Florida hospitals.
